headline: EnerCom Announces SM Energy as a Keynote Speaker at the 31st EnerCom Denver - The Energy Investment Conference, on August 19, 2026, in Denver, Colorado
summary: EnerCom, Inc. ("EnerCom") is pleased to announce that Beth McDonald, President & CEO of industry leader SM Energy, has been confirmed as a keynote speaker at the 31st annual EnerCom Denver – The Energy Investment Conference, on August 19, 2026, at the Westin Denver Downtown.

headline: Is CLB Stock Attractive After Its Sharp Selloff and Mixed Q2 Results?
summary: Core Laboratories stock looks cheaper after a 47.1% six-month selloff, but falling earnings and geopolitical pressure keep the near-term case cautious.

headline: 5 Must-Read Analyst Questions From SLB’s Q2 Earnings Call
